description: NestJS API bootstrap + Auth module + Tenant/Permission guards. Depends on FEAT-001 (shared packages, Prisma schema, Docker Compose). Creates the complete apps/api application: main.ts bootstrap, PrismaModule, ConfigModule with Joi env validation, correlation ID middleware, global exception filter, health endpoint, Swagger, and the full auth flow (login/refresh/logout/forgot-password/reset-password/accept-invitation with Argon2id, JWT, HttpOnly cookies, rate limiting). Also creates TenantMiddleware (sets RLS context per request), JwtAuthGuard, PermissionsGuard, and AuditModule. This FEAT is independent of FEAT-003 and FEAT-004 but must come before FEAT-003.
steps: Create apps/api/package.json: name @rims/api, scripts (build: nest build, dev: nest start --watch, start: node dist/main, lint, type-check: tsc --noEmit, test: jest, test:e2e), dependencies: @rims/shared-types workspace:*, @nestjs/common@10.4.7, @nestjs/config@3.3.0, @nestjs/core@10.4.7, @nestjs/jwt@10.2.0, @nestjs/passport@10.0.3, @nestjs/platform-express@10.4.7, @nestjs/swagger@7.4.2, @nestjs/throttler@6.2.1, @prisma/client@5.22.0, argon2@0.41.1, bullmq@5.13.2, class-transformer@0.5.1, class-validator@0.14.1, cookie-parser@1.4.7, helmet@8.0.0, ioredis@5.4.1, joi@17.13.3, passport@0.7.0, passport-jwt@4.0.1, reflect-metadata@0.2.2, rxjs@7.8.1, uuid@10.0.0. devDependencies: @nestjs/cli@10.4.9, @nestjs/schematics@10.1.4, @nestjs/testing@10.4.7, @types/cookie-parser, @types/express, @types/jest@29.5, @types/node@22, @types/passport-jwt, @types/uuid, jest@29.7, ts-jest@29.2.5, typescript@5.7.2. Jest config: rootDir src, testRegex *.spec.ts, moduleNameMapper for @rims/* packages.

Create apps/api/tsconfig.json (extends ../../packages/config/tsconfig.nestjs.json, outDir dist, rootDir src, baseUrl ., paths: @rims/shared-types -> ../../packages/shared-types/src/index.ts, @rims/validation -> ../../packages/validation/src/index.ts). Create apps/api/nest-cli.json (collection @nestjs/schematics, sourceRoot src, deleteOutDir true).

Create apps/api/src/config/env.validation.ts: Joi schema validating all .env vars (DATABASE_URL required, REDIS_URL required, JWT_ACCESS_SECRET required min 32 chars, JWT_REFRESH_SECRET required min 32 chars, PORT default 3000, NODE_ENV default development, CORS_ORIGIN, THROTTLE_TTL default 60, THROTTLE_LIMIT default 100, SMTP_* optional). Export envValidationSchema.

Create apps/api/src/modules/prisma/prisma.service.ts: extends PrismaClient, implements OnModuleInit/OnModuleDestroy. Constructor: log warn+error events, query events in development only. onModuleInit: $connect with error logging. onModuleDestroy: $disconnect. transaction<T>(fn, options?): calls $transaction. setTenantContext(tenantId: string): $executeRaw`SELECT set_config('app.current_tenant_id', ${tenantId}, true)`. Create prisma.module.ts (global: true).

Create apps/api/src/common/middleware/correlation-id.middleware.ts: generate uuid v4 requestId, set on req.requestId, set response header x-request-id. Create apps/api/src/common/filters/http-exception.filter.ts: catches all exceptions, returns { error: { code, message, details, requestId } }, never exposes stack trace in production. Create apps/api/src/common/interceptors/response-transform.interceptor.ts: wraps successful responses in { data: ..., meta: { requestId, timestamp } }.
Create apps/api/src/modules/health/health.controller.ts: GET /health returns { status: 'ok', uptime: process.uptime(), timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }. No auth guard on this endpoint.

Create apps/api/src/main.ts: NestFactory.create(AppModule), app.use(helmet()), app.use(cookieParser()), app.enableCors({origin: corsOrigin, credentials: true}), app.setGlobalPrefix('api/v1'), app.useGlobalPipes(ValidationPipe whitelist+forbidNonWhitelisted+transform), app.useGlobalFilters(HttpExceptionFilter), app.useGlobalInterceptors(CorrelationIdMiddleware as interceptor, ResponseTransformInterceptor), Swagger setup (title RIMS API, version 0.1.0, addBearerAuth, setup at /api/docs), app.listen(port). Structured startup log.

Create apps/api/src/app.module.ts: imports ConfigModule.forRoot({validate: envValidationSchema, isGlobal: true}), PrismaModule, ThrottlerModule.forRoot([{ttl: 60, limit: 100}]), HealthModule, AuthModule, TenantModule, AuditModule, UsersModule, RolesModule, TenantsModule, InstitutionModule, DepartmentsModule, TeamsModule, EmployeesModule. Apply CorrelationIdMiddleware globally (NestMiddleware configure).

Create TenantModule: apps/api/src/modules/tenant/tenant.middleware.ts resolves tenant from JWT claim tenantId OR from Host header matched against tenant_domains table via PrismaService. Stores on request as req.tenant. Calls prisma.setTenantContext(tenant.id). Apply to all routes except /health and /auth/login. Create apps/api/src/common/guards/tenant.guard.ts (throws 403 if req.tenant absent), jwt-auth.guard.ts (validates JWT, attaches user), permissions.guard.ts (reads @RequirePermissions metadata, checks user's role permissions via PrismaService cache). Create apps/api/src/common/decorators/require-permissions.decorator.ts, current-tenant.decorator.ts, current-user.decorator.ts.

Create AuthModule: apps/api/src/modules/auth/. auth.service.ts implements: login(dto) — find user by email+tenantId, verify Argon2id hash, create session row with hashed refresh token (crypto.randomBytes(32) hashed with SHA-256), sign JWT access token (15m, payload {sub, email, tenantId, permissions[]}), return {accessToken} + set HttpOnly SameSite=Strict refresh cookie. refresh(refreshToken) — find session by token hash, check not expired/revoked, atomically delete old + create new session, issue new access token + new cookie. logout(sessionId) — revoke session. forgotPassword(email) — find user, create Invitation(type=PASSWORD_RESET, tokenHash, expiresAt=now+1h), enqueue email job to BullMQ 'email' queue; always return 200. resetPassword(token, newPassword) — find invitation by tokenHash, check expiry, hash new password with Argon2id, update user, mark invitation used, revoke all sessions. acceptInvitation(token, name, password) — find invitation type=USER_INVITE, activate UserTenantMembership, set password, mark used. auth.controller.ts: 6 POST endpoints, all with @Throttle({short: {ttl:60, limit:5}}). jwt.strategy.ts: validate JWT, return user from DB. dtos/*.dto.ts: LoginDto, RefreshDto, ForgotPasswordDto, ResetPasswordDto, AcceptInvitationDto — all with class-validator decorators.

Create AuditModule: apps/api/src/modules/audit/audit.service.ts: log(event: CreateAuditEventDto): never throws, calls prisma.auditEvent.create, catches errors and logs to stderr. audit.controller.ts: GET /audit-events, paginated (page/pageSize query params), filter by resourceType/actorId/dateFrom/dateTo, @RequirePermissions('audit.view'), returns PaginatedResult<AuditEvent>.

Write unit tests: apps/api/src/modules/auth/auth.service.spec.ts (mock PrismaService, test login success, wrong-password 401, Argon2 verify called, refresh token rotation, logout revokes session). apps/api/src/modules/audit/audit.service.spec.ts (test log never throws even when prisma throws). apps/api/src/common/guards/permissions.guard.spec.ts (allow with permission, deny without).
acceptance_criteria: pnpm --filter @rims/api test exits 0 with all auth and audit unit tests passing
POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid seeded credentials returns access token and sets Set-Cookie refresh token header
POST /api/v1/auth/login with wrong password returns 401 with { error: { code, message, requestId } }
Request without tenant context to any protected endpoint returns 403
POST /api/v1/auth/login 6th time within 1 minute returns 429 (rate limit)
verification: pnpm --filter @rims/api dev & sleep 5 && curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/v1/health | grep ok
